dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Single prominent thick white band across the greater coverts with high grayscale contrast against the dark slate-gray wing body.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: High prominence and sharp boundary of pale white edges along the outer vanes of the folded flight feathers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: A distinct, roughly rectangular yellowish-white patch located centrally on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp, distinct linear transition from black crown to white nape patch, then to olive-green mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent black ventral stripe extending from the throat down the center of the yellow breast.
